description: Complete the naming: pass the BODY_JSON from prepare_name_acceptor UNCHANGED and the signature your wallet produced over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Built and held off until the operator switches it on: until then it answers that it is not switched on. Relays to the same public door any HTTP client uses (POST /labor/work/:workId/acceptor); this server holds no keys and no funds. FREE with a valid signature, and the signature is YOURS, from the wallet that posted the job. NOBODY IS PAID by this call. Returns which seat the named person took. Vealth is not a party to this job: it does not decide this proof, it does not accept it, and it gives no permission for your place. Cost and signer: free, no gas; signed by the person's own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

bodyJson.description: The exact BODY_JSON string from prepare_name_acceptor, unchanged.
